payload.text: The bidirectional reflection distribution function (BRDF) describes how outgoing light power depends on incoming light, surface normal, wavelength, and directions.
BRDF models how surfaces reflect light depending on direction, wavelength, and surface properties, essential for realistic rendering and vision analysis.
